name: Zalaerdőd (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Zalaerdőd (a yellow shield with a crown, a cross and an oak leaf) below the name ZALAERDŐD in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
